failures.assertion: Describes hang symptoms (0% CPU, sleeping state, no established network connections) from the recorded PID or its child, not from searching processes by name.
failures.evidence: It inspects the child via `pgrep -P "$pid" | xargs -r ps -o pid,etime,stat,rss,args` but only mentions "elapsed time, process state, memory use and the last log lines," never describing 0% CPU, a sleeping state, or the absence of established network connections.
